contract: POST /login candidate recorded from server/Auth.js:322. Method, path, query/body variants, auth/permission gates, payload shape/types, errors and side effects must match upstream v2.37.2.
exceptions: Denial coverage is the inactive-user fixture plus the wrong-password wire regression; other malformed-login variants are not promoted.

invariants.contract: Sampled POST /login via differential case(s) login, reader-login: status, auth path and payload shape/types compare equal (after recorded normalizations) between the pinned upstream server and the Go implementation. Category samples: authentication.
exceptions: Sampled evidence; unsampled request-shape variants are separate behaviors.

invariants.contract: The sampled inactive-user and wrong-password denials match passport's default 401 response: exact Unauthorized bytes, Content-Length: 12, no Content-Type and no chunked transfer. net/http sniffing is suppressed with a present nil Content-Type header; no compatibility exception or header normalization is used.
exceptions: Sampled the inactive-user creation-time path; the same Go writer and the same upstream passport default serve all local-login denials.

invariants.contract: Successful login JSON response uses Express res.json semantics: Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8, weak W/"<hexlen>-<sha1>" ETag whose length prefix equals the body bytes, non-HTML-escaped JSON, and issuance of a FRESH signed connect.sid session cookie (passport logIn regeneration) with Path=/ and HttpOnly in addition to (or instead of, for X-Return-Tokens) the refresh-token cookie.
exceptions: etag digest/content-length normalize because the payload's backupPath embeds per-copy fixture root names; the W/"<len>-" prefix consistency is checked per side. JSON member order: Go emits alphabetically sorted object keys while upstream keeps insertion order; recorded member order is not a verified compatibility surface (candidate exception, owner approval pending).
